newsitem.title: NORWAY: UBN sees continued margin pressure.
newsitem.headline: UBN sees continued margin pressure.

text.p: Union Bank of Norway (UBN), the country's largest savings bank, said on Thursday prospects for the rest of the year were good but that pressure on interest margins were expected to continue.
"The board of directors expects that 1996 will be a good financial year," the bank said in a statement accompanying the nine-month result.

"The customer margin has now been stable for a period but we expect pressure on the margin to continue," it said. "Net interest income has risen through 1996 but is significantly lower than in 1995. Other income is developing in a positive manner. The growth in costs is high and losses continue to be low. This trend is expected to continue."
